preconditions.description: The length of the input string is not more than 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '_' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only lowercase and uppercase letters, digits, and '_' symbols.

invariants.expression: output_string == 'YES' if any(friend in input_string for friend in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) and sum(input_string.count(friend) for friend in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) == 1 else 'NO'
invariants.description: The output is 'YES' if the input string contains one of Alex's friends' names exactly once, and 'NO' otherwise.
